name: objection - Runtime Mobile Exploration (Frida)
description: objection is a Frida-powered, no-code runtime toolkit for Android and iOS. From an interactive REPL it bypasses SSL pinning and root/jailbreak detection, dumps keychain/keystore and memory, lists classes/methods, patches activities, and explores the filesystem - all without writing Frida scripts or repackaging.
notes:
=== INSTALL (needs frida-server running) ===
  pip install objection

=== START A SESSION ===
  objection -g <target> explore          # -g = package id / bundle id

=== INSIDE THE REPL ===
  android sslpinning disable             # kill cert pinning
  android root disable                   # bypass root detection
  ios sslpinning disable
  ios jailbreak disable
  android keystore list
  ios keychain dump
  memory search '<pattern>' --string
  android hooking list classes
  android hooking search methods <keyword>
  android hooking watch class_method <method> --dump-args --dump-return
  env                                    # app directories
  file download <remote> <local>

=== PATCH AN APK WITH THE GADGET (no root) ===
  objection patchapk -s <file>           # injects frida-gadget, re-signs

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  frida (raw scripts)     # more control
  MobSF dynamic analyzer
  apktool static patching

examples.label: Patch an APK with the Frida gadget

recommended.note: objection is built on Frida; drop to raw scripts for control.
MobSF for a broader automated assessment.

defense.why_it_works: objection drives Frida to override client-side security methods at runtime, so pinning, root/jailbreak detection, and keystore protections implemented only on the client are defeated with prebuilt commands.
defense.prerequisites: A rooted/jailbroken device (or an app patched with the Frida gadget) and the app installed.
defense.impact: Traffic interception, secret/keychain extraction, and manipulation of client-side controls without any scripting.
defense.detection: Same as Frida: on-device RASP detects frida-gadget/server and hooking; server-side attestation flags tampered or hooked clients.
defense.artifacts: frida-gadget library in a repackaged app, on-device Frida indicators, attestation failures.
defense.prevention: RASP with hook/Frida detection; Play Integrity/App Attest enforced server-side; never rely solely on client checks; encrypt and server-gate sensitive data; detect re-signed/debuggable builds.
